question: Can the core + AC winding loss of the candidate chokes be bounded tightly enough to decide the 65 kHz / 90 kHz frequency trade, using the core MATERIAL's published loss data and the core geometry?
decision_rule: A candidate wins only if its increase in DC+AC+core loss over the retained Wurth 760800301 is less than the switching saving (19.3765 W at 65 kHz, 11.8202 W at 90 kHz).

core_identification.manufacturer: Wurth Elektronik eiSos GmbH & Co. KG (Midcom)
core_identification.core_series_or_size: T75 (family/package size; NOT a core-material or core-shape designation)

core_material.reason: The datasheet does not state a core material. The only 'Material' fields (pages 3-4) are packaging: 'PET' (tray) and 'Paper' (paperboard). A manufacturer family presentation (raw/we-torpfc-totem-pole-e-mobility.pdf, p.7) states the series uses BOTH 'High Flux cores: Ni-Fe' and 'Sendust: Al-Si-Fe' with no per-part mapping.

geometry.reason: No core geometry or turns are published in the datasheet, the family product table, the PFC-choke catalog table (the 'n' column is '-' for WE-TORPFC), or the LTspice/PSpice models. Only external package dimensions (OD 99 mm, H 62 mm) are given.

core_identification.manufacturer: Wurth Elektronik eiSos GmbH & Co. KG (Midcom)

core_material.reason: Not published per part. Family-level statement covers High Flux (Ni-Fe) and Sendust (Al-Si-Fe) without a mapping. Part-number/ISAT covariance is present across the family (e.g. 760800202 ISAT 19 A vs 760801202 ISAT 37 A at the same 389 uH / T50 / 50 mOhm) but no primary source states which material corresponds to which suffix, so this is an inference and is recorded as NOT a source.

geometry.reason: Not published (see baseline reason). External package dimensions only: OD 72 mm max, H 45 mm max.

core_identification.manufacturer: Wurth Elektronik eiSos GmbH & Co. KG (Midcom)

geometry.reason: Not published. External package dimensions only: OD 53 mm max, H 50 mm max.

material_loss_data_used.per_part_material_reason: No source maps a part number to a core material; therefore no material-specific loss curve can be selected.

family_material_statement.quote: Introducing WE-TORPFC (High Flux cores: Ni-Fe, Sendust: Al-Si-Fe)

material_ceiling_used.quantity: saturation flux density ceiling Bsat = 1.5 T
material_ceiling_used.source: raw/mag-inc-high-flux-cores.html (Magnetics, core manufacturer): High Flux composition Ni-Fe, 'high saturation flux density (15,000 gauss)'
material_ceiling_used.class: manufacturer HTML product page (NOT a datasheet); used only as an upper ceiling
material_ceiling_used.note: Highest Bsat among the family's two candidate materials; used to bound the flux swing from above, never as this part's material.

material_core_loss_curves_available_but_.reason: Available, but cannot be converted to watts without the core volume and cannot be assigned to a part without the per-part material.

flux_swing_derivation.identity: For a uniform-flux toroid, L(I)*I = N*Ae*B(I), so N*Ae = L(I)*I/B(I).

upper_bound.validity: B <= Bsat for any magnetic core, so this is a genuine upper bound; it is conservative because B at the operating peak is below Bsat for 760801202 (ISAT 37 A >> 23.27 A). L cancels, so it is material- and geometry-independent given the ceiling.
upper_bound.assumption: Bsat <= 1.5 T (High Flux, the highest of the family's candidate materials).

lower_bound.reason: No published upper bound on N*Ae (core size x turns), so the flux swing cannot be bounded from below.

ac_winding_resistance_vs_frequency.reason: Not published for any WE-TORPFC part at 65-90 kHz. The datasheet gives only a 20 C max DCR; the family presentation notes flat wire 'minimized skin effect' qualitatively but gives no R_ac/R_dc data at these frequencies; wire thickness and turns are not published, so no bound can be formed.
